per_object_cap.stated: 60 minutes per job on the free grant; 360 minutes only on a paid parallel job

retention.stated: artifacts and logs follow pipeline retention settings; the minute pool is monthly

egress.terms: no egress charge on the hosted agent itself

interface_detail: an azure-pipelines.yml pipeline; a REST API and the az CLI
tooling: the Microsoft-hosted images; any shell; the Azure CLI preinstalled
chaining: 1,800 minutes is the largest per-job-minute pool of the small providers, and the 60-minute job cap is the smallest

limits.value: 60 minutes per job on the free grant
1,800 minutes a month with 1 free parallel job

identity_cost.detail: an Azure subscription is required, which means a payment instrument, even when the grant is free

evidence.proved: one free parallel job with 1,800 minutes a month and a 60-minute maximum job duration; 10 GB of disk; the 360-minute cap applies only with a paid parallel job

notes: The 60-minute job cap is the smallest of any provider here and it is the number that excludes a user's work. The subscription requirement is the second gate.
